source.quoted_text: Sch I-A Art. 5 (both columns): 'AGREEMENT OR MEMORANDUM OF AN AGREEMENT ... (c) If not otherwise provided for — Fifty rupees.' Delhi's Schedule I-A has NO specific works-contract article (unlike Maharashtra Art 63); a works contract executed in Delhi is stamped as an Art 5(c) agreement.
